description: This file defines the runmode-standalone.js module for CodeMirror, providing functions for syntax highlighting and tokenization, including StringStream class, mode resolution, and runMode execution.

classes.name: StringStream
classes.description: A class providing string parsing utilities for syntax highlighting, including methods like eat, eatWhile, match, column, indentation, lookAhead, baseToken.

methods.name: copyObj
methods.description: Copies properties from one object to another, with optional overwrite control.

methods.name: countColumn
methods.description: Counts the column offset in a string, considering tab characters.

methods.name: createObj
methods.description: Creates a new object with a specified prototype and optional properties.
